From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

The 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup included teams whose rosters consisted of 12 players; a team may opted to have one naturalized player as per FIBA eligibility rules in their roster.[1][2][3]

Age and club were as of the start of the tournament, 25 August 2023.[4]

[edit source]

A 23-player roster was announced on 26 May.[5][non-primary source needed] The final roster was announced on 23 August.[6]

Philippines

[edit source]

A 21-player roster was announced on 6 June.[15] It was reduced to 16 players after the exclusions of Carl Tamayo, Jordan Heading, and Poy Erram due to injuries and the commitment of Utah Jazz guard Jordan Clarkson to play for the country as its naturalized player. The final roster was announced on 23 August.[16]

Group C

[edit source]

Greece

[edit source]

A 22-player roster was announced on 20 July.[31] On 13 August, it was reduced to 14 players.[32] The final roster was announced on 19 August.[33] Dinos Mitoglou suffered an injury shortly before the tournament and had to withdraw.[34] Because the replacement deadline had passed, Mitoglou could not be replaced.
